gloss: New Year's party; New Year's gathering

definitions.gloss: New Year's party; New Year's gathering
definitions.explanation: A social gathering or party held in early January to celebrate the new year, typically organized by workplaces, clubs, or groups of friends. Counterpart to the year-end party ({忘年会|ぼうねんかい}).

examples.japanese: {新年会|しんねんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}された。
examples.english: I was put in charge of organizing the New Year's party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新年会|しんねんかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{第二週|だいにしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The company New Year's party is held in the second week of January.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サークル→サークル：10933_saakuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新年会|しんねんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}えた→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I got to see everyone again for the first time in a while at the university club's New Year's party.

notes:
An important social custom in Japan, especially in the workplace. The {新年会|しんねんかい} is the counterpart to the ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧ (year-end party). While the ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧ aims to forget the troubles of the outgoing year, the {新年会|しんねんかい} marks a fresh start and sets a positive tone for the year ahead.
